Large flops_to_first_use (5392) also hides proxy issue latency. Lane parallelism outweighs trigger's cheaper per-op stage.

?:?:_Z16eval_reuse_batchPN4gicc9DeviceCt.rationale: grid_blocks=1 gives no proxy lane parallelism: 5.37+32*2.872 ~= 97us proxy vs 7.88+32*1.033 ~= 41us trigger. descriptor_reusable=true amortizes host staging further; 32 ops is far past the ~1.4-op crossover.

?:?:_Z16eval_tiny_singlePN4gicc9DeviceCt.rationale: Single 256B op, not in a loop: proxy 5.37+2.872=8.24us vs trigger 7.88+1.033=8.91us. Below the ~1.36-op crossover the lower fixed cost favors proxy, though the margin is thin.

?:?:_Z17eval_large_singlePN4gicc9DeviceC.rationale: 1 MiB at 24 GB/s is ~44us of link time, dominating both lowerings' fixed overheads (~8us proxy vs ~8-16us trigger). Evidence is too weak to pin a lowering; keep the IPC_OR_DWQ baseline.

?:?:_Z19eval_adjacent_batchPN4gicc9Devic.rationale: grid_blocks=1 serializes 16 proxy issues (5.37+16*2.872 ~= 51us) versus trigger 7.88+16*1.033 ~= 24us; coalescable=true lets the host merge adjacent descriptors into one DWQ release.

?:?:_Z19eval_dynamic_offsetPN4gicc9Devic.rationale: Proxy is the only legal action (hk_capable=false, max_vector_bytes=1 blocks descriptor reconstruction), so preserve the device op with CPU proxy work.

?:?:_Z21eval_static4_parallelPN4gicc9Dev.rationale: Four independent static sites may occupy distinct proxy lanes; 4 sites x 4 blocks = 16 producers over 8 lanes gives ~2 serialized issues per lane (~11us) versus host-serial trigger staging of all 16 descriptors (7.88+16*1.033 ~= 24us).
Same scenario as the sibling static sites: independent static callsites map to distinct proxy lanes (grid_blocks=4, lanes=8), so parallel proxy issue beats serial host staging through DWQ.

Independent static site with grid_blocks=4 and only 4 ops; proxy lane concurrency (bounded by 8 lanes) keeps issue cost near the 5.37us fixed term, while trigger would add its 7.88us fixed cost plus serial staging shared with the sibling sites.

Consistent with the other three static sites in this kernel: distinct proxy lanes allow concurrent issue of the 16 total ops, which is cheaper than host-side staging of the same descriptors through a single DWQ release path.
